bugClass.title: Child process inherits an incompatible locale
bugClass.cause: A child process emits locale-dependent text while the consuming parser or identity comparison assumes a fixed locale, causing timestamp parsing or process ownership checks to misinterpret output.
bugClass.criteria: Classify another site when either (1) a spawned process inherits the parent locale and emits human-formatted timestamps or identities consumed by code expecting a fixed locale, or (2) parsing/comparison logic assumes a C/English representation without enforcing that locale in the child environment. Either path qualifies independently.

candidates.evidence: Lines 10-16 call execFile('ps', ... 'lstart=...') without a locale override, then parse lstart using an English-shaped timestamp regex. The child inherits the parent locale, so localized month output can fail the fixed-format parser.

At lines 75-76, execFileSync runs ps -p <pid> -o lstart= without enforcing a locale, then compares the output to known.started. The child inherits the process environment, so locale-dependent lstart text can mismatch the stored identity timestamp; no LC_ALL/LANG guard is visible.

Lines 87-89 spawn a detached Node child with env from reportServerEnvironment(port, process.env, ...), but the excerpt does not show locale-dependent output or a parser/identity comparison consuming such output.

Lines 15-18 use execFile with env merged from process.env, allowing locale inheritance, but the excerpt only reports exit status and stdout and shows no locale-dependent parser or identity comparison.

Lines 80-96 spawn a sleep daemon and run ps -p ... -o lstart=, then persist the timestamp from stdout. This visibly creates locale-sensitive lstart output, but the excerpt does not show the consuming parser or identity comparison, nor a missing locale guard.

At lines 10-14, execFile('ps', ['-o','lstart=','-p',...]) visibly requests a locale-dependent start timestamp and returns trimmed text, but the excerpt does not show a fixed-locale assumption or the downstream parser/comparison.
Line 144 spawns an attached Docker process with inherited daemon.env and piped stdio, but the excerpt does not show locale-dependent output being parsed or identity-compared.
Line 23 spawns a CLI process with merged environment variables, but the excerpt does not show a locale-dependent output parser, identity comparison, or an enforced fixed locale.

Lines 17-20 show `execFile` with an explicit `env` containing PATH, HOME, and other variables but no locale setting. The excerpt does not show a locale-dependent child output, timestamp/identity parser, or triggering consumer.

Lines 4-6 spawn Electron with env inherited from process.env, but the excerpt shows only process lifecycle handling and no locale-dependent child output consumed by fixed-locale parsing or identity logic.
Lines 94-106 spawn a provider command with taskEnvironment(resources), but the excerpt shows no locale-dependent output, timestamp/identity parser, or locale enforcement detail.
Lines 141-153 spawn commands with commandEnvironment(options.env), but no locale-dependent child output or consuming parser/comparison is visible in the excerpt.

Lines 26-38 spawn a verification shell with verifyEnvironment() and describe a clean login environment, but the excerpt does not establish its locale contents or show locale-dependent output being parsed or compared.

Lines 6-18 spawn a child with inherited default environment and redirect its output to a log. The excerpt shows no parser or identity comparison consuming locale-dependent text, nor a timestamp/ownership trigger.
